children: Crude palm oil prices are expected to stay above 4,100 ringgit a ton in December, having most bearish factors already priced in, says the Malaysian Palm Oil Council in a note. Additional support may come from geopolitical uncertainty, potential restrictions by the Indonesian government on exports amid an expected decline in production, it says. The risk of Malaysian oil palms entering a biological rest phase after two consecutive years of record output in 2025 and 2026 could also support CPO prices, it adds. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
